name: @qayaba/web
description: Operator/value web dashboard for qayaba. A self-contained vanilla JS console (no build step) in web/public/, served same-origin by the orchestrator at /app (src/server/static.ts). Talks only to /api/v1/* and the SSE live feed, through a mock adapter (offline demo data) and a live adapter that mirrors @qayaba/sdk method-for-method. See web/public/README.md and web/public/API.md.
